mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type IN (0, 1, 2) WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type = 3 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(csr.renew_amount), 0) FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type IN (0, 1, 2) WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}

SELECT csr.renew_type AS type, csr.renew_type AS typeLabel, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(csr.renew_amount), 0) AS amount FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}
GROUP BY csr.renew_type

SELECT t.butler_owner_user AS butlerUser, COALESCE(MAX(t.butler_owner_user_name), t.butler_owner_user) AS butlerUserName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS expiringCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN csr.renew_type IN (0,1,2) THEN t.id END) AS renewedCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN csr.renew_type IN (0,1,2) THEN t.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.id), 2) END AS renewalRate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN csr.renew_type IN (0,1,2) THEN csr.renew_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS renewAmount FROM company_service t LEFT JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end} AND t.butler_owner_user IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.butler_owner_user ORDER BY expiringCount DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(csr.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(csr.renew_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type IN (0, 1, 2) WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND csr.create_time >= #{start} AND csr.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(csr.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(csr.create_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(csr.renew_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type IN (0, 1, 2) WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND csr.create_time >= #{start} AND csr.create_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(csr.create_time, '%m-%d'), DATE(csr.create_time) ORDER BY DATE(csr.create_time)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.wish_finish_time IS NOT NULL AND t.wish_finish_time < CURDATE() AND (t.real_finish_time IS NULL OR t.real_finish_time > t.wish_finish_time) AND (t.status IS NULL OR t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FINISHED')) AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(t.current_owner_user, t.owner_user) AS ownerUser, COALESCE(MAX(t.current_owner_user_name), MAX(t.owner_user_name), MAX(COALESCE(t.current_owner_user, t.owner_user))) AS ownerUserName, COUNT(*) AS totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FINISHED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.wish_finish_time IS NOT NULL AND t.wish_finish_time < CURDATE() AND (t.real_finish_time IS NULL OR t.real_finish_time > t.wish_finish_time) AND (t.status IS NULL OR t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FINISHED')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueTasks, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FINISHED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS completionRate FROM common_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.create_time >= #{start} AND t.create_time <= #{end} AND COALESCE(t.current_owner_user, t.owner_user) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.current_owner_user, t.owner_user) ORDER BY totalTasks DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT TRIM(csr.renew_reason) AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type = 3 AND csr.renew_reason IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(csr.renew_reason) != '' WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}
GROUP BY TRIM(csr.renew_reason) ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM company_service t INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = t.id AND csr.deleted = 0 AND csr.renew_type = 3 AND (csr.renew_reason IS NULL OR TRIM(csr.renew_reason) = '') WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date >= #{start} AND t.end_date <= #{end}
